svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 750 x 156 x 3; sits on the side walls and bulkheads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue a 20 mm tongue under the front edge that slides under a lip on the firewall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One M4 nylon thumb screw at the back into a captive nut on the rear wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8.5 mm hole for the GNSS mast, 660 back from the front edge, on the centre line; the Core's GNSS receiver sits on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three 6.5 mm holes beside the mast for the Core's antennas on SMA extension leads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a slot for the lockable arming switch next to the mast (see the harness plan).
